idea-plugin.name: Suno MCP
idea-plugin.description:
AI Music Generation with Suno via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

This plugin helps you set up the MCP Suno server with JetBrains AI Assistant. Once configured, AI Assistant can generate songs, lyrics, covers, remixes, and more using Suno AI — all powered by Ace Data Cloud.

Features

  • 35 AI Music Tools — Generate, extend, cover, remix, mashup, stems, and more
  • Easy Setup — One-click copy MCP configuration for AI Assistant
  • Dual Mode — STDIO (local) and HTTP (remote) server support
  • Token Management — Store API token securely in IDE settings

Available Tools

  • Generate — Create songs from text prompts or custom lyrics
  • Extend — Continue a song from a specific timestamp
  • Cover — Create covers and remixes in different styles
  • Mashup — Blend multiple songs together
  • Stems — Separate vocals and instruments
  • Lyrics — Generate and optimize lyrics
  • Persona — Save and reuse voice styles
  • Export — Get MP4, WAV, MIDI, and timing data

Quick Start

  1. Install this plugin
  2. Open Settings → Tools → Suno MCP
  3. Enter your Ace Data Cloud API token
  4. Click Copy Config and paste into Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → MCP

Requires uv (Python package runner) for STDIO mode, or use HTTP mode for zero-install remote access.

Get your Ace Data Cloud API key

  1. Open Ace Data Cloud → Applications. Sign in, or register an account first.
  2. Find General application. If it has not been created, choose Initialize General Application. A general key can use the services available to your account; a dedicated application's key is limited to its service. Check the required service/model access and current pricing.
  3. Copy the API Key from the application card, or open Keys / Manage Keys → Create to create a separate key for this integration. Give it a recognizable name so you can revoke or rotate it independently.
  4. When creating a key, review Expiration Time, Set Usage Limitation, and Allowed APIs. Enable only the restrictions you need, allow the operations you will call, then click Create and copy the token from the key list. Task lookup does not grant permission to submit a generation. Confirm the application's balance can cover your first request; any trial allowance is whatever your account currently displays.
  5. Copy only the token value, without quotation marks, spaces, or Bearer . An API Key / API Token field expects this raw value; only a manually configured HTTP Authorization header needs the Bearer prefix. A platform-... account-management token cannot replace a generation API key.

Save the key in the client's credential store or the environment variable shown below. Never put it in a prompt, shared workflow, screenshot, or Git commit. If authentication fails, check the full copied value, application/service access, expiration, usage limit, and balance before creating another key.
